svg.aria-label: A three-step ascending stair on a navy field, with the bottom step rendered as a dashed outline, the middle step half-filled in slate, and the top step solid in electric blue with a copper-gold edge highlight.
svg.title: The AI readiness gap — incomplete foundations
svg.desc: A 2.5D isometric stair ascends from lower-right to upper-left in three steps. The bottom step is drawn as a dashed outline only — incomplete. The middle step is half-filled in muted slate. The top step is solid in confident electric-blue with a thin copper-gold highlight along its top edge, suggesting an inference layer attempting to stand on incomplete foundations.
